name: Washtenaw FMC 2 2025

venue.name: Morris J. Lawrence Building
venue.address: 4800 E Huron River Dr, Ann Arbor, MI 48105

information:
**This is not a regular speedsolving competition and does NOT feature speedsolving events.**
The only event at this competition is FMC and there will not be normal 3x3.
If you are a new competitor, we recommend registering for [Washtenaw Spring 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WashtenawSpring2025), which is being held the day after this competition in the same building.
This competition takes place on a **FRIDAY** evening. Guests may only be in the room during official FMC attempts if they are quiet for the duration of the FMC attempt.
